entities.name: Panopticon
entities.description: A darksteel fortress inside Mirrodin, later Karn's throne, then the Seedcore and Elesh Norn's Throne Room.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: The hollow plane containing the Panopticon.

entities.name: Memnarch
entities.description: Mad golem who controlled his artifact minions from the Panopticon.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: Silver golem who put Memnarch in charge, later infected and imprisoned in the Throne Room.

entities.name: Glissa
entities.description: Person whose return to the core Memnarch anticipated.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: Phyrexian praetor who restored the Panopticon and made it a prison for Karn.

entities.name: Jin-Gitaxias
entities.description: Praetor whose servants hijacked the Panopticon.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: Visited the Panopticon with Karn's head to use the Darksteel Eye.

entities.name: Darksteel Eye
entities.description: Memnarch's device letting the world be viewed through the myr.

entities.name: Realmbreaker
entities.description: Grew from the World Tree essence planted in Karn's empty seat.

entities.name: Vanishing
entities.description: Event in which the main structure of the Panopticon was annihilated.

events.summary: Karn puts Memnarch in charge of the plane and the palace is named Galdroon.
events.quote: When Karn put Memnarch in charge of the plane, the palace was named Galdroon

events.summary: The green lacuna blasts through the Panopticon and topples it; Memnarch and Malil rebuild it.
events.quote: Memnarch and Malil started reconstruction efforts on the tower afterwards

events.summary: Slobad builds the Ascension Web for Memnarch; at the Vanishing the Panopticon is annihilated.
events.quote: Upon the Vanishing , the main structure of the Panopticon, as well as its reconstruction disk, was annihilated.

events.summary: The infected Karn retreats to the core and the Panopticon becomes his throne; Jin-Gitaxias's servants hijack it.
events.quote: the Panopticon was converted into his throne

events.summary: Elesh Norn restores the Panopticon and Tezzeret uses the Darksteel Eye with Karn's head.
events.quote: After the rise of Elesh Norn , she restored the Panopticon to its full functionality.

events.summary: The Panopticon becomes a prison for Karn and the World Tree essence grows into the Seedcore and Realmbreaker.
events.quote: converted into a prison for Karn

relations.note: put in charge of the plane by Karn
relations.quote: When Karn put Memnarch in charge of the plane
was a fortress inside of the hollow plane of Mirrodin
converted into a prison for Karn
